item.title: Banking architecture, late modernism and exposed concrete in Porto Alegre — Brazil
item.description: Referências Justin Read. Alternative Functions: Oscar Niemeyer and the Poetics of Modernity. In: Modernism/modernity, Volume 12, Number 2. Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, April 2005, pp. 253-272 (254). It starts with the overvalue under the reinforced concrete structural shape, the Luccas, Luis Henrique Haas. Concreto aparente e valorização da estrutura: a influência estética do Brutalismo em Porto Alegre nos anos 60/70. In: X DOCOMOMO_Brazil Seminar: brutalist connections 1955-75. PUC-PR Curitiba, 15-18 out.
